messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [Alert] Unusual RBAC change detected in prod cluster

mia_sec: seen the alert. what's the binding? any service account name?

raj_oncall: alert details: audit log shows `kubectl create rolebinding` at 2025-09-15T02:13:20Z by CI service account `ci-deployer@redwood-prod` targeting cluster-admin.

dina_devex: that's odd — CI shouldn't create cluster-admin RBs. last deploy pipeline had a k8s manifest change? @ops-lead-ella can you check deploy history?

ops-lead-ella: looking now. build 9842 ran 02:12:40Z, step 'apply-manifests' used `k8s-deploy-robot` SA. No explicit rolebinding in git diff. Possible transient manual run?

mia_sec: okay, snapshot current binding and remove if unauthorized. steps:
1) `kubectl get rolebinding prod-superbind -n kube-system -o yaml > /tmp/prod-superbind.yaml`
2) `kubectl delete rolebinding prod-superbind -n kube-system`
3) rotate token for `k8s-deploy-robot` and create patch to prevent create rolebinding right away

raj_oncall: grabbing snapshot now.

raj_oncall: ```
# prod-superbind snapshot
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: prod-superbind
  namespace: kube-system
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: k8s-deploy-robot
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-admin
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
``` 

dina_devex: thx. agree delete. will open PR to revoke `k8s-deploy-robot` perms in infra namespace and add e2e guard in deploy pipeline.

ops-lead-ella: deleted rolebinding @ 02:19:20Z. Noted in audit: https://console.logs/audit/xyz (link)

mia_sec: escalate to sec-postmortem channel, capture timeline. raj, take incident lead for the night; handoff to morning team at 09:00 UTC with artifacts: snapshot, pipeline logs, rotated tokens, PR link.

raj_oncall: ack. creating incident doc in confluence and assigning tasks.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-20250915-7 and set severity P2

mia_sec: quick mitigation tasks (recorded):
- rotate SA keys and revoke tokens for `k8s-deploy-robot`
- block CI runner IPs from k8s-admin operations until root cause
- add admission controller rule to deny ClusterRoleBinding creations from CI service accounts

ops-lead-ella: added temporary network ACL to block CI runners from kube-api (applied)

dina_devex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/452 (revoke perms + pipeline guard)

raj_oncall: handing off to morning oncall @ 09:00 UTC. will include timeline and artifacts in the incident doc.

mia_sec: thanks team. continue monitoring logs for related anomalies. :thumbsup:
